# MAUSE OS / Godot Minimalist Red and Black Theme

Author: Bokx's Game Asset Store.
Official source: https://bokx.itch.io/mause-os-minimalist-ui-theme-for-godot
Retrieved: 2026-10-15. Official file: Sifi Minimalist Theme.tres.
The official page declares code MIT and assets CC BY 4.0:
https://opensource.org/license/mit/ and https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

CAP modification: styles_only.tres selects the original StyleBoxFlat/Line/Empty
resources and color mappings. It excludes all embedded fonts, cache-backed
textures/icons and font sizes. Runtime integration preserves CAP's Korean font,
paper document styles and layout; it adapts state mappings and margins.
This is an integration sample, not the full original pack. No endorsement implied.
